archive_order: C-order (x,y,z), z fastest; transposed (z,y,x) before VTK structured-grid input, including damage array.
surface_method: vtkGeometryFilter extracts exterior quadrilateral faces from a vtkStructuredGrid whose points and scalar damage are the original per-frame arrays.
surface_boundary: Connects material-point centres; nominal plate outline is inset by half a particle spacing. Damage is interpolated linearly over connected structured cells; no geometry scaling, damage smoothing, or scalar remapping.
jacobian_check: Each cell sampled at center, 8 corners and 8 two-by-two Gauss locations; all sampled signed Jacobians must be positive. This is a finite sample inversion check, not an exhaustive continuous proof.

jacobian_audit.sampling: cell center, 8 corners, and 8 2x2x2 Gauss points
